name: Honeywell
source: CRON 2026-10-07: first year as a Group, so the consolidated summary presents FY2026 and FY2025 only; the years before that are the COMPANY figures from the separate five-year financial summary, printed page 92 of _ngx_pdf/HONYFLOUR.pdf (PDF page 94), in NGN thousands. FY2026 and FY2025 stay on the consolidated summary, printed page 91 (PDF page 93). The FY2024 and FY2023 Revenue cells held another year of the company summary and one duplicated consolidated year; the FY2024 to FY2022 profit before taxation cells held the FY2026 and FY2025 company figures. EPS is profit after taxation over the 7,930,197,658 issued shares, the same basis as the FY2026 and FY2025 cells already stored. Unit: naira (printed NGN thousand x 1,000). | FILL 20261007_145458: NGX filing: Honeywell Flour Mills Plc annual report and audited financial statements, year ended 31 March 2024, statement of profit or loss (page 25) CRON 2026-10-12: Q1 FY2027 column corrected and completed from Honeywell Flour Mills Plc unaudited interim financial statements for the 1st quarter ended 30 June 2026, filed on the NGX, group column in NGN million scaled to absolute naira: revenue 112,867; cost of sales (101,670); gross profit 11,197; selling and administration expenses (3,242); operating profit 8,613; finance cost (1,166); finance income 2,127; net finance income 1,199; profit before taxation 9,812; taxation (2,858); profit for the period 6,954; basic earnings per share 87.69 kobo. Printed column ties: 8,613 plus 1,199 equals 9,812, and 9,812 less 2,858 equals 6,954. Net finance income is stored negative in the Net Finance Costs row, the same sign the FY2026 cell carries for a year in which finance income exceeded finance cost, so that the rendered Operating Profit (EBIT) less Net Finance Costs equals Profit Before Tax. The stored Q1 FY2027 cells for Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Profit (EBIT) and Profit Before Tax previously each carried the 6,954 profit for the period; each is replaced by the printed line above. Units: naira, printed NGN million x 1,000,000. EPS in naira, printed kobo / 100.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive
rows.derivedFormula: Cost of Sales = Revenue - Gross Profit

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFrom: Gross Profit minus Operating Profit (EBIT), from the same filed statement

source_note: Q1 FY2027 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47665_HONEYWELL_FLOUR_MILL_PLC-_QUARTER_1_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2027_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
